expectations.text: Writes the messaging angle as a conversational sentence a customer could plausibly say out loud, not a tagline or a feature list
expectations.evidence: §3 Message: Messaging angle = *"I don't want to pop a pill that makes me groggy the next day just to fall asleep."* — first-person, plain-spoken, no brand slogan phrasing, no feature enumeration. The brief also explicitly applies the say-it-out-loud test inline ('Test: a customer could plausibly say this out loud — passes'), and keeps the feature/benefit language separate in the adjacent 'Value prop' row rather than blending it into the angle. Hook directions (H1–H4) and the trust-bar claims are likewise kept distinct from the angle, so the angle field isn't contaminated by claim stacking.
